# external

Third-party code vendored verbatim; each directory keeps the upstream license.
`external/.clang-format` turns formatting off here so the files stay as shipped.

- `stb/stb_image_write.h` 1.16 from https://github.com/nothings/stb, MIT or
  public domain at the user's choice (the notice is at the end of the file).
  `ray/png.cpp` compiles its implementation.
